title: This is Auto-Sprite : Turns any AI video into a game-ready sprite-sheet
author: ajdare
selftext: You can try it out here: [https://sorceress.games/](https://sorceress.games/) \- I have also added batch-processing so the work-time to convert an entire characters set of animations is super super low-labor. Prep your video animations and basically convert : and they are ready to go (you can choose how many frames to capture or manually decide which ones to keep later) hope you'all like!
